newsitem.title: USA: ADT, Western in talks to drop bid.
newsitem.headline: ADT, Western in talks to drop bid.

text.p: ADT Ltd said it has held talks with Western Resources Inc about a potential termination of Western's takeover bid for the electronic security company.
The talks also concern the settlement of Western's proxy fight and the settlement of litigation between the two companies, ADT said in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
"These discussions are ongoing. However, there can be no assurance that any agreement will be reached with Western," ADT said in the filing.
Western, which holds a 27 percent stake in ADT, offered in December to buy the rest of ADT.
ADT rejected the bid as inadequate and in March announced a $5.4 billion merger agreement with Tyco International Ltd. ADT and Western also are involved in litigation over the proposed takeover bid.
A spokesowman for Western said the company is continuing to review its options regarding the ADT investment. She declined further comment on the status of the talks.
